stem: A repair requires cord-and-plug equipment where workers are likely to contact irrigation water. What is the best first control decision?
choices: Use any tool if the floor is wiped immediately before work
Hold the cord above waist height throughout the repair
Wear two pairs of gloves and keep the task under five minutes
Verify the equipment is approved for the location and follow the facility's electrical-work controls before use
rationale: OSHA requires portable electric equipment and flexible cords used where employees are likely to contact water or conductive liquids to be approved for those locations.
